verdict.rationale: Offline reading, searching, and writing with sync on reconnect is a fair question for an email product, so the axis applies. However, AgentMail's evidence documents only online API, CLI, MCP, webhook, and WebSocket access, with no first-party offline mode or reconnect-sync. Its IMAP/SMTP support lets third-party clients like Thunderbird connect, but any offline behavior would come from those external clients. That is a user-side workaround and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can read, search, and write email offline, with changes syncing when I reconnect
